summary: This note argues that people should learn about their local hospital's resources before an emergency. It surveys services such as emergency departments, diagnostics, specialized units, outpatient care, telehealth, support services, rehabilitation, prevention programs and financial counseling, citing named experts and dated events. It closes with ways to become familiar with these resources and stresses that preparation improves outcomes and eases stress.
one_line: A guide to the range of services at local hospitals and why learning about them before an emergency improves care and outcomes.
key_facts: As of September 5, 2023, hospitals have expanded beyond emergency and surgical care to include integrated treatment plans, rehabilitation services, and holistic wellness programs.
Dr. Angela Martinez, Director of Community Outreach at St. Luke's Medical Center, said patients should view their hospital as 'a partner in their overall health management.'
Emergency Departments like the one at Riverdale Hospital operate 24/7, and Riverdale's ED has been lauded for its rapid-response stroke team.
Dr. Marcus Yeung said at a November 12th, 2023 medical symposium that diagnostic and lab services are often the front line in identifying conditions quickly.
Gracewell Hospital inaugurated its new cardiac wing in December 2023, offering advanced treatments for heart diseases.
Hospital administrator James Peterson emphasized on February 15th, 2024 that understanding scheduling and referral for outpatient services streamlines care.
Healthwatch Magazine's March 2024 issue reported that local hospitals continue to offer virtual doctor's visits for non-emergency issues.
Emily Thompson found hospital support groups critical to her recovery after a health scare in early 2024.
Physical therapist Leon Chang of Highland Rehabilitation Center advises exploring post-op rehab options well before planned surgeries.
Franklin Community Hospital issued a community health calendar on September 13th, 2023 listing education programs like smoking cessation, diabetes management, and prenatal care.
Financial counselor Sarah-Lynn Hewitt said in an October health seminar that awareness of financial aid services can ease anxieties during health crises.
Ways to familiarize yourself include visiting the hospital website, taking a community tour, attending health events, and asking providers.
Dr. Rebecca O'Neil said in a January 2024 interview that patients who understand services can advocate for themselves, leading to improved outcomes.
